dialogues.jp:
果たして――俺があの傍若無人な妹の脅しに屈
するかと思えば。
dialogues.en:
See if my pretty sister can terrify me by threatening into
doing what she wants.
dialogues.text:
See if my pretty sister can terrify me by threatening into
doing what she wants.

dialogues.jp: 屈するに決まっている。
dialogues.en: I'm sure I will give in.
dialogues.text: I'm sure I will give in.

dialogues.jp: 体育館の隅で一人目元をぬぐう。
dialogues.en: I wipe my eyes at the corner of the gymnasium.
dialogues.text: I wipe my eyes at the corner of the gymnasium.

dialogues.jp:
「はい、パーティー会場となる体育館からの実
　況生中継です」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, this is a live broadcast from the gymnasium where the
party will be held."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, this is a live broadcast from the gymnasium where the
party will be held."

dialogues.jp: 寒い目で俺の周囲から人が消えた。
dialogues.en: People give me cold looks and walk away.
dialogues.text: People give me cold looks and walk away.

dialogues.jp:
「うぅ……俺だってこんなところに居たくない
　んだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I don't wanna be here."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I don't wanna be here."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いかんな。逃げちゃダメだぞ朝倉」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, don't run away from this, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "C'mon, don't run away from this, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
人波がひいて、はじめて杉並がすぐ横に立って
いたことに気づく。
dialogues.en:
I notice Suginami standing right next to me after
everybody's left.
dialogues.text:
I notice Suginami standing right next to me after
everybody's left.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、なにしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふっ……木を隠すには林」
dialogues.en: "Huh, only the woods can cover a tree."
dialogues.text: "Huh, only the woods can cover a tree."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺を同類にして欲しくは無いが、林というほ
　ど、お前のテンションについていけるやつは
　居ないと思うぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want to belong to the same species as you. Plus, it
sounds crazy when you say you're the woods."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want to belong to the same species as you. Plus, it
sounds crazy when you say you're the woods."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「むしろ双璧といったところか」
dialogues.en: "I should say I'm rather a double wall."
dialogues.text: "I should say I'm rather a double wall."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……あくまで俺を同類にしたいらしいな」
dialogues.en: "No matter what, you want me to be in your team, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "No matter what, you want me to be in your team, don't you?"

dialogues.jp: こいつ友達少ないんじゃないか？
dialogues.en: I think he doesn't have many friends.
dialogues.text: I think he doesn't have many friends.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、今回のミスコンの主催はどこなんだ？
　またお前メインか？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, do you know who's the host of the beauty pageant
this year? Is it you again?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, do you know who's the host of the beauty pageant
this year? Is it you again?"

dialogues.jp: あいかわらず盛況な体育館内を示す。
dialogues.en: He points at the crowded gymnasium.
dialogues.text: He points at the crowded gymnasium.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「クリスマスと同じ手芸部だ。彼らがドレスを
　作ってくれるとあって、意外な人気がでてな」
dialogues.en:
"It's the handicraft club again. They make dresses for them,
so it got very popular."
dialogues.text:
"It's the handicraft club again. They make dresses for them,
so it got very popular."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「洋服にかける女性の執念か……」
dialogues.en: "It's all about girls' obsession with clothes, huh..."
dialogues.text: "It's all about girls' obsession with clothes, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「男がまんべんなく妹好きなのと変わらんな」
dialogues.en: "It is the same thing as a man loving his little sisters."
dialogues.text: "It is the same thing as a man loving his little sisters."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それは偏見……」
dialogues.en: "That's a distorted view."
dialogues.text: "That's a distorted view."

dialogues.en: Right?
dialogues.text: Right?

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、いい……で、お前はなんでここにいる
　んだ？」
dialogues.en: "Who cares? By the way, why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Who cares? By the way, why are you here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん仕掛けのお披露目を確認にな」
dialogues.en: "I'm here to make sure my plan will go smoothly."
dialogues.text: "I'm here to make sure my plan will go smoothly."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「え？　ここ？　ミスコンでやるの？」
dialogues.en: "What? Does it have to happen in the beauty pageant?"
dialogues.text: "What? Does it have to happen in the beauty pageant?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うむ」
dialogues.en: "Uh-huh."
dialogues.text: "Uh-huh."

dialogues.jp: 呆れる俺をよそに、杉並が自信満々に頷く。
dialogues.en: Suginami nods proudly, ignoring my surprise.
dialogues.text: Suginami nods proudly, ignoring my surprise.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て！？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a second!"
dialogues.text: "Wait a second!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢が出場することを考えて、どんどん思考が
嫌な方向に流れる。
dialogues.en:
Knowing that Nemu's going to be on stage, I can't help an
ominous sense of foreboding.
dialogues.text:
Knowing that Nemu's going to be on stage, I can't help an
ominous sense of foreboding.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……今回はなにをするつもりだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you going to do this time?"
dialogues.text: "What are you going to do this time?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「うむ。作戦名“舞台上でマリリン・モンロー”
　の仕込みの確認にな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it is called 'Marilyn Monroe on the stage', and I
need to test it."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it is called 'Marilyn Monroe on the stage', and I
need to test it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「もしかして……下から風が吹いてきてスカー
　トがめくれると……」
dialogues.en:
"You mean, you make a gust of wind to blow their skirts up
or something..."
dialogues.text:
"You mean, you make a gust of wind to blow their skirts up
or something..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なにせ一番手は朝倉妹だ。ここで生足のひと
　つやふたつを炸裂させれば――ん？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, your sister will be on first. So, my plan is to make
one or both of her pretty legs get blown away by an
explosion."
dialogues.text:
"Well, your sister will be on first. So, my plan is to make
one or both of her pretty legs get blown away by an
explosion."

dialogues.jp:
とんとん、と笑顔で杉並の肩を叩き、そのまま
指を天井に向ける。
dialogues.en:
I tap Suginami's shoulder with a smile, then point my finger
up to the ceiling.
dialogues.text:
I tap Suginami's shoulder with a smile, then point my finger
up to the ceiling.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「上になにが――」
dialogues.en: "What's up there?"
dialogues.text: "What's up there?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Hah!!"
dialogues.text: "Hah!!"

dialogues.jp: 杉並が、のろのろと腹部に視線を落とす。
dialogues.en: Suginami looks down at his abdomen.
dialogues.text: Suginami looks down at his abdomen.

dialogues.jp:
だが、そこには俺の｛しょうてい／掌底｝がめりこんだ跡がある
だけだ。
dialogues.en: But my fist only left a small dent.
dialogues.text: But my fist only left a small dent.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「バカな……この技は……対サイボーグ気功術」
dialogues.en:
"You've got to be kidding. That trick requires a Cyborg Chi
power."
dialogues.text:
"You've got to be kidding. That trick requires a Cyborg Chi
power."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……ゲームのやりすぎだ」
dialogues.en: "You are into computer games a bit too much."
dialogues.text: "You are into computer games a bit too much."

dialogues.jp: てい、と首の後ろに手刀を落とす。
dialogues.en:
I make a chopping motion on the back of his neck with my
hand.
dialogues.text:
I make a chopping motion on the back of his neck with my
hand.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Oohh..."
dialogues.text: "Oohh..."

dialogues.jp: ぱたり、と杉並が床に崩れ落ちた。
dialogues.en: Suginami falls down on the floor.
dialogues.text: Suginami falls down on the floor.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったる」
dialogues.en: "Phew... What a pain in the neck!"
dialogues.text: "Phew... What a pain in the neck!"

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、舞台の仕掛けをはずしに俺は走
――ろうとしたけど歩いた。
dialogues.en:
Anyway, I try to run to get the device off of the stage. But
actually I walk.
dialogues.text:
Anyway, I try to run to get the device off of the stage. But
actually I walk.

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「あー、マイクマイク……おっけー」
dialogues.en: "Uhh, testing, testing, one, two, three... Okay."
dialogues.text: "Uhh, testing, testing, one, two, three... Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Announcer
dialogues.jp: 「お、始まったか。タイミングばっちり」
dialogues.en: "Oh right, great timing."
dialogues.text: "Oh right, great timing."

dialogues.jp:
体育倉庫のマットで簀巻きにした杉並を、風紀
委員に引き渡したとこで放送が入る。
dialogues.en:
I've just handed Suginami over to the discipline committee
--he's rolled up in a mattress in the gym equipment storage
room-- and the announcement starts.
dialogues.text:
I've just handed Suginami over to the discipline committee
--he's rolled up in a mattress in the gym equipment storage
room-- and the announcement starts.

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp: 「えー、大変長らくお待たせしました」
dialogues.en: "Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for waiting."
dialogues.text: "Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for waiting."

dialogues.jp: 潮のように、館内のざわめきがすっと遠のく。
dialogues.en: As the tide ebbs, the crowd in the gym suddenly quiet down.
dialogues.text: As the tide ebbs, the crowd in the gym suddenly quiet down.

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp:
「少々トラブルなどもありまして、予定を大幅
　に遅らせてのスタートとなりましたが、皆様
　ぜひ最後までお付き合いください」
dialogues.en:
"Welcome to the 'Miss Kazami Academy Contest', hosted by the
handicraft club!"
dialogues.text:
"Welcome to the 'Miss Kazami Academy Contest', hosted by the
handicraft club!"

dialogues.jp: わーっ、と暇人共が叫ぶ。
dialogues.en: There are cheers erupting from the audience.
dialogues.text: There are cheers erupting from the audience.

dialogues.jp:
その中でため息をつく俺を、周りの何人かが訝
しげな顔で振り返る。
dialogues.en:
Hearing me sigh, some people turn toward me and give me a
quizzical glance.
dialogues.text:
Hearing me sigh, some people turn toward me and give me a
quizzical glance.

dialogues.jp:
どんな結果になろうと、俺にとっては面倒なこ
とにしかならないじゃないか……。
dialogues.en:
Whatever turns out, it'll be a pain in the neck for me, I
believe.
dialogues.text:
Whatever turns out, it'll be a pain in the neck for me, I
believe.

dialogues.jp: いや、分かっていたことか。
dialogues.en: It's got to be.
dialogues.text: It's got to be.

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp:
「それではエントリーＮｏ１。手芸部推薦の本
　命！　風見学園付属３年１組――朝倉音夢さ
　んです！」
dialogues.en:
"Here is entry number 1. The favorite recommended by the
handicraft club, from senior class one, Nemu Asakura!"
dialogues.text:
"Here is entry number 1. The favorite recommended by the
handicraft club, from senior class one, Nemu Asakura!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、皆さんごきげんよう」
dialogues.en: "Ah, hello, how are you, everybody?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, hello, how are you, everybody?"

dialogues.jp:
あ、なんか笑顔だけど、内心で後悔しているの
がなんとなく分かる。
dialogues.en:
I see her smiling, but I know in the back of her mind she's
wishing she wasn't here.
dialogues.text:
I see her smiling, but I know in the back of her mind she's
wishing she wasn't here.

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉さんはクリスマスに続いての登場で、つ
　いに頂上対決という図式となりましたが今の
　心境は？」
dialogues.en:
"This is your second time in a row to enter. How does it
feel, being in the semifinal against the top?"
dialogues.text:
"This is your second time in a row to enter. How does it
feel, being in the semifinal against the top?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「頂上……って白河さんのことですよね……い
　え、私は別にそんなつもりは……」
dialogues.en:
"The top means Shirakawa-san, right? No, I don't have any
feelings against her."
dialogues.text:
"The top means Shirakawa-san, right? No, I don't have any
feelings against her."

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp: 「では、なぜ今回参戦なさったんです？」
dialogues.en: "Then, why did you enter the contest a second time?"
dialogues.text: "Then, why did you enter the contest a second time?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
う〜ん。あいかわらず、あの司会者はピンポイ
ントに人の揚げ足をとっていくな。
dialogues.en: I see the MC is trying to trip her up.
dialogues.text: I see the MC is trying to trip her up.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく応援してやるつもりで、壇の近くま
で寄ることにする。
dialogues.en: I get closer to the stage to give her moral support.
dialogues.text: I get closer to the stage to give her moral support.

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp: 「ドレスが可愛かったからですか？」
dialogues.en: "Because you liked the dress?"
dialogues.text: "Because you liked the dress?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Excuse me?"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me?"

dialogues.jp:
そんな理由でミスコンに出るやつなんていない
だろう。
dialogues.en:
Who in the world would enter a beauty pageant for that
reason?
dialogues.text:
Who in the world would enter a beauty pageant for that
reason?

dialogues.jp:
落ち着けば答えなんていくらでもあるのだろう
が、壇上で上がっているのか音夢の反応は鈍い。
dialogues.en:
There are lots of answers she could give if she were
relaxed, but she seems to be nervous on stage, which is
slowing down her reactions.
dialogues.text:
There are lots of answers she could give if she were
relaxed, but she seems to be nervous on stage, which is
slowing down her reactions.

dialogues.jp: 「おーい」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp: 暗がりの中で、軽く手を振る。
dialogues.en: I wave at her in the darkness.
dialogues.text: I wave at her in the darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Oh, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Brr!"
dialogues.text: "Brr!"

dialogues.jp:
マイクで拡声されているのに、音夢がなんの気
もなく声を上げてしまった。
dialogues.en: Nemu raised her voice in the microphone involuntarily.
dialogues.text: Nemu raised her voice in the microphone involuntarily.

dialogues.jp: 「バカ！　俺のことは気にするな！」
dialogues.en: "You idiot! Don't worry about me!"
dialogues.text: "You idiot! Don't worry about me!"

dialogues.jp: 前を向けと手を振るが――。
dialogues.en: I give her a sign to face forward, but...
dialogues.text: I give her a sign to face forward, but...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
こちらの小声は届いていないだろうが、あいつ、
おどおどと俺に視線を寄せる。
dialogues.en:
I know she can't hear my whispering, so she falteringly
tries to focus on me.
dialogues.text:
I know she can't hear my whispering, so she falteringly
tries to focus on me.

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp:
「おーっと、朝倉さんはお兄さんのために出場
　したんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Mmm..., I see. You are here for your brother, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "Mmm..., I see. You are here for your brother, aren't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Um... yeah."
dialogues.text: "Um... yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Yipe!?"
dialogues.text: "Yipe!?"

dialogues.jp: 悪い意味で裏モードが起動した。
dialogues.en: She's been booted into her bad mode.
dialogues.text: She's been booted into her bad mode.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ、兄さんが私のドレス姿が見たいという
　もので」
dialogues.en:
"Well, because he really wanted to see me in the pretty
dress."
dialogues.text:
"Well, because he really wanted to see me in the pretty
dress."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て……」
dialogues.en: "Hold on..."
dialogues.text: "Hold on..."

dialogues.jp:
前回の二の舞のような状態に、思わず膝をつき
そうになる。
dialogues.en:
I almost drop to my knees, thinking of last time all over
again.
dialogues.text:
I almost drop to my knees, thinking of last time all over
again.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.jp:
暗がりでいまいちはっきりしないが、さくらの
小さな手が背中に当てられている。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure who's next to me in the darkness, but I can
feel Sakura's tiny hand on my back.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure who's next to me in the darkness, but I can
feel Sakura's tiny hand on my back.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「早く避難したほうがいいよ」
dialogues.en: "You'd better get out now."
dialogues.text: "You'd better get out now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I know."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I know."

dialogues.jp: この状況では、仕方がないだろう。
dialogues.en: I have no other choice in this situation.
dialogues.text: I have no other choice in this situation.

dialogues.jp: 悪いな、と手で謝って俺は体育館から脱出――。
dialogues.en:
I apologize to Nemu by waving my hand, then I get out of the
gymnasium.
dialogues.text:
I apologize to Nemu by waving my hand, then I get out of the
gymnasium.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……待って」
dialogues.en: "Wait for me, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Wait for me, niisan."

dialogues.jp: 静かな呟きが、大きく響く。
dialogues.en: The quiet call echoes loudly through the mic.
dialogues.text: The quiet call echoes loudly through the mic.

dialogues.jp: 俺の鼓動も大きく揺れる。
dialogues.en: I feel my pulse quicken.
dialogues.text: I feel my pulse quicken.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Niisan."
dialogues.text: "Niisan."

dialogues.jp: 動けなくなった。
dialogues.en: I am frozen.
dialogues.text: I am frozen.

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.en: "Uhhh~"
dialogues.text: "Uhhh~"

dialogues.jp: アナウンサーも、今の状況がつかめないらしい。
dialogues.en: Even the MC doesn't know exactly what's going on here.
dialogues.text: Even the MC doesn't know exactly what's going on here.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私を置いていかないで」
dialogues.en: "Don't leave me here."
dialogues.text: "Don't leave me here."

dialogues.jp:
声は冷静を努めているが、今の音夢は混乱して
いる。
dialogues.en: She tries to sound very calm, but I can feel she is upset.
dialogues.text: She tries to sound very calm, but I can feel she is upset.

dialogues.jp: 置いていくわけじゃない。
dialogues.en: I don't mean to leave her.
dialogues.text: I don't mean to leave her.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、あいつは自分が望んであそこにいるん
じゃない。
dialogues.en: I know she's not on the stage of her own will.
dialogues.text: I know she's not on the stage of her own will.

dialogues.jp:
自業自得なのだろうが、あいつにそんな器用な
振る舞いが出来ないことを俺は知っていた。
dialogues.en:
It's a case of divine justice. Besides, I knew from the
beginning she couldn't deal with this.
dialogues.text:
It's a case of divine justice. Besides, I knew from the
beginning she couldn't deal with this.

dialogues.jp:
今、下手にここから居なくなろうとすれば、あ
いつは叫ぶかも知れない。
dialogues.en: If I try to sneak away, she might scream.
dialogues.text: If I try to sneak away, she might scream.

dialogues.jp: あのマイクを使って。
dialogues.en: Through the microphone.
dialogues.text: Through the microphone.

dialogues.jp: 俺のことを――。
dialogues.en: At me...
dialogues.text: At me...

dialogues.jp: 互いの本当の気持ちを。
dialogues.en: About the feelings we have for each other.
dialogues.text: About the feelings we have for each other.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私は兄さんが」
dialogues.en: "I think you are..."
dialogues.text: "I think you are..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「やめろ音夢……」
dialogues.en: "Stop, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Stop, Nemu."

dialogues.jp: 思わず呟いていた。
dialogues.en: I realize I'm mumbling.
dialogues.text: I realize I'm mumbling.

dialogues.jp:
こんなところで俺達のことを話したら、せっか
くの卒業式になにが起こるか――
dialogues.en:
If she speaks up about us in public, what kind of graduation
ceremony would it be?
dialogues.text:
If she speaks up about us in public, what kind of graduation
ceremony would it be?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃん、他の人ならいいのに、ボクが関
　わると不安定になるね」
dialogues.en:
"Nemu seems to be all right when it comes to other people,
but if it's about me, she gets upset, doesn't she?"
dialogues.text:
"Nemu seems to be all right when it comes to other people,
but if it's about me, she gets upset, doesn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: すっ、と手が伸びる。
dialogues.en: I feel a hand.
dialogues.text: I feel a hand.

dialogues.jp: バン！
dialogues.en: Bang!
dialogues.text: Bang!

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "A blackout?"
dialogues.text: "A blackout?"

dialogues.jp: 体育館の中が一瞬のうちに真っ暗になる。
dialogues.en: The lights go off in the gymnasium.
dialogues.text: The lights go off in the gymnasium.

dialogues.speaker: Schoolgirl
dialogues.jp: 「みなさん動かないでください！」
dialogues.en: "Don't move, everybody!"
dialogues.text: "Don't move, everybody!"

dialogues.speaker: MC
dialogues.jp: 「危ないから動かないでくださ〜い！」
dialogues.en: "It's dangerous, so please don't move!"
dialogues.text: "It's dangerous, so please don't move!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「皆さん、ただの停電ですから静かにその場で
　動かないでくださ〜い！」
dialogues.en:
"Everybody, it's just a blackout, so please stay still where
you are!"
dialogues.text:
"Everybody, it's just a blackout, so please stay still where
you are!"

dialogues.jp:
風紀委員と中央委員会が各所で上手く対応して
いる。
dialogues.en:
The discipline committee and the central committee are
handling this chaos very well.
dialogues.text:
The discipline committee and the central committee are
handling this chaos very well.

dialogues.jp:
ざわ、とパニックの波が背筋を駆け抜けたが、
水たまりの波紋のレベルで騒ぎは静まった。
dialogues.en:
I thought this would fly out of control, but they've stayed
in control.
dialogues.text:
I thought this would fly out of control, but they've stayed
in control.

dialogues.en: "Whew..."
dialogues.text: "Whew..."

dialogues.jp: 冷や汗をぬぐうように顎に手をそえる。
dialogues.en: I wipe cold sweat off my forehead.
dialogues.text: I wipe cold sweat off my forehead.

dialogues.jp:
「……こういう時、ウチの学生の能力はさすが
　としか言いようがないな」
dialogues.en: "I'm amazed how well they can control the situation."
dialogues.text: "I'm amazed how well they can control the situation."

dialogues.jp:
音夢やことりが毎日打ち合わせなどを行ってい
るのも、こうなるとバカには出来ないわけだ。
dialogues.en:
I won't belittle Nemu and Kotori any more for working hard
on the project.
dialogues.text:
I won't belittle Nemu and Kotori any more for working hard
on the project.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、行こう」
dialogues.en: "Let's go, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Let's go, oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
目が慣れて、ようやく周囲の景色がぼんやりと
映るようになる。
dialogues.en: My eyes have adjusted a bit, and I can see a little clearer.
dialogues.text: My eyes have adjusted a bit, and I can see a little clearer.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あぁ」

なぜか、さくらは私服姿だったが、今は退散す
るのが先だろう。
dialogues.en:
I don't know why Sakura isn't in uniform, but all I have to
do now is to get out of here.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why Sakura isn't in uniform, but all I have to
do now is to get out of here.

dialogues.jp: 音夢に呼ばれた気がした。
dialogues.en: I thought I heard Nemu calling me.
dialogues.text: I thought I heard Nemu calling me.

dialogues.jp: 壇上に影が｛たたず／佇｝んでいる。
dialogues.en: I see the vague shadow on the stage.
dialogues.text: I see the vague shadow on the stage.

dialogues.jp:
何かを口にしたはずなのに、その声はマイクを
通らず闇とざわめきの中に消えた。
dialogues.en:
She said something, but her voice disappeared into the chaos
without going through the microphone.
dialogues.text:
She said something, but her voice disappeared into the chaos
without going through the microphone.

dialogues.jp: あいつは泣いているのだろうか。
dialogues.en: She may be crying.
dialogues.text: She may be crying.

dialogues.jp: 助けてやりたいけれど、今はなにも出来ない。
dialogues.en: I wish I could help her.
dialogues.text: I wish I could help her.

dialogues.jp:
俺が行ってしまえば、あいつは泣き出すだろう。
そうなれば、何を噂されるか分からない。
dialogues.en:
If I leave her, she'll cry for sure. Then people might start
spreading gossip about us.
dialogues.text:
If I leave her, she'll cry for sure. Then people might start
spreading gossip about us.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「悪いのはお兄ちゃんじゃないよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not your fault, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "It's not your fault, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: なぜだろう。
dialogues.en: I don't know why.
dialogues.text: I don't know why.

dialogues.jp:
意味は分からなかったし、何気ない声だったの
に、俺にはさくらも泣いているような気がした。
dialogues.en:
I didn't know what she meant, but her voice was quiet. Now I
get the feeling Sakura has been crying as well.
dialogues.text:
I didn't know what she meant, but her voice was quiet. Now I
get the feeling Sakura has been crying as well.

dialogues.jp: ◆ミスコンでの騒ぎ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Chaos in the beauty pageant◆
dialogues.text: ◆Chaos in the beauty pageant◆

dialogues.jp:
予想通りに面倒なことになりそうな第二回風見
学園ミスコンテスト。
dialogues.en:
The second beauty pageant of Kazami Academy was held, and I
was expecting some kind of trouble.
dialogues.text:
The second beauty pageant of Kazami Academy was held, and I
was expecting some kind of trouble.

dialogues.jp:
予想通り、根回しと話術の上手いアナウンサー
に好きな人を聞かれた音夢が、危うく俺の名前
を言いそうになる。
dialogues.en:
As I anticipated, when the MC, who's very good at the
behind-the scene work and eloquent in speech, asked Nemu
about her love interest, she almost said my name.
dialogues.text:
As I anticipated, when the MC, who's very good at the
behind-the scene work and eloquent in speech, asked Nemu
about her love interest, she almost said my name.

dialogues.jp:
そんな中、さくらが俺の側に現れた瞬間、体育
館の電気が落ちて、音夢の声もマイクを通るこ
とはなかった。
dialogues.en:
As soon as Sakura showed up next to me, there was a blackout
in the gymnasium, and Nemu couldn't be heard through the
microphone any longer.
dialogues.text:
As soon as Sakura showed up next to me, there was a blackout
in the gymnasium, and Nemu couldn't be heard through the
microphone any longer.

dialogues.jp:
そうして、俺は騒ぎになりそうな体育館を、さ
くらと一緒に脱出したのだった。
dialogues.en: So I rushed out of the gym with Sakura to avoid the chaos.
dialogues.text: So I rushed out of the gym with Sakura to avoid the chaos.
